bug_semantics: With saveLogs enabled, a caller authorized to execute an action can supply a nonempty, nonduplicate StartAction UniqueTrackingId containing slash and .. segments. OliveTin accepts that string, stores it as the log entry's ExecutionTrackingID, interpolates it into the .yaml and .log filenames, and passes those names to path.Join. path.Join cleans the traversal segments, so ioutil.WriteFile writes both files outside the configured log directories to attacker-selected paths writable by the OliveTin process.
flaw_origin: The existing API-to-executor path already accepted arbitrary client tracking strings. PR #300's sole member commit fe991045b5bd9c7fbe57bb83a12a56deca68ef06 first made that unsafe value filesystem-relevant by adding stepSaveLog, composing filenames from ExecutionTrackingID without validation or basename confinement, joining them to configured directories, and writing them. GitHub integrated that one-member commit as squash commit 8fd98874e2b62c693cf2ab086f6c006020507760 with the same tree; the squash aggregate is not used as the BIC.
ai_marker: absent: git cat-file -p fe991045b5bd9c7fbe57bb83a12a56deca68ef06 shows human author and committer jamesread <contact@jread.com>, message 'feature: Save logs! #174', no bot identity, and no Co-Authored-By, Generated-with, or other AI-attribution trailer.
evidence: First-party advisory https://github.com/OliveTin/OliveTin/security/advisories/GHSA-364q-w7vh-vhpc identifies the UniqueTrackingId-to-path.Join traversal, CVE-2026-31817, affected releases through the pre-fix line, and patched release 3000.11.2; the bundle's Go advisory range is < 0.0.0-20260309102040-b03af0e2eca3. In the validated full-history clone, git blame at parent dc6f6c2896f953d2f55421df80da09bdd1926ec4 shows internal/grpcapi/grpcApi.go:64-73 assigning req.UniqueTrackingId to ExecutionRequest.TrackingID and invoking ExecRequest; internal/executor/executor.go:131-150 explicitly notes random client strings, copies req.TrackingID into ExecutionTrackingID, and replaces only duplicates or empty IDs. git log -L on the filename line identifies integration commit 8fd98874e2b62c693cf2ab086f6c006020507760. refs/pull/300/head resolves to sole PR member fe991045b5bd9c7fbe57bb83a12a56deca68ef06; git log dc6f6c2..fe99104 contains only that member, and git cat-file shows both fe99104 and 8fd9887 have tree abda7c392f104f1679db3dbc76bd54cea64909a5. At fe99104, internal/executor/executor.go:111 adds stepSaveLog; lines 470-474 interpolate ExecutionTrackingID and call both save functions; lines 487-512 path.Join the filename into configured result/output directories and ioutil.WriteFile .yaml/.log files. Direct parent-tree check `git grep -n -e stepSaveLog -e saveLogResults -e saveLogOutput -e SaveLogs dc6f6c2896f953d2f55421df80da09bdd1926ec4 -- internal/executor/executor.go internal/config/config.go` returns no matches, while the BIC diff adds all 63 saveLogs lines. Version membership: tag 2024.04.28 targets f467c69e8f256ef5cd46d49512cb11aaa8df22d2, whose immediate parent is integration 8fd9887, so the vulnerable tree shipped there; tag 3000.11.2 targets b03af0e2eca3d564abd5604868069f94dc798de0. Direct fix 2f77000de44f65690f257e3cf8e2c8462b0e74c7 adds a 36-character hex/hyphen tracking-ID validator and changes ExecRequest to replace every invalid value with a UUID. git log --ancestry-path confirms 2f77000 is an ancestor of b03af0e, and git grep at b03af0e confirms validTrackingIDPattern and the !isValidTrackingID guard in service/internal/executor/executor.go:34-39,518. Advisory fix: https://github.com/OliveTin/OliveTin/commit/2f77000de44f65690f257e3cf8e2c8462b0e74c7; patched release: https://github.com/OliveTin/OliveTin/releases/tag/3000.11.2.
reasoning: The vulnerability requires both an attacker-controlled tracking ID and a file sink. Commit 381bf59fbd79e8a122bf3b4052789863c86d89f5 had already propagated UniqueTrackingId into the executor, and dc6f6c2's tree demonstrably accepted any nonempty, nonduplicate value, but that alone did not create this file-write path. The smallest causal change is therefore the saveLogs member fe99104, which first concatenated that already-untrusted value into filenames and wrote them after path.Join cleaning. Its immediate parent has the source but none of the saveLogs configuration, execution step, filename construction, or write helpers, directly proving absence. The public PR head reconstructs the one-member history behind GitHub's same-tree squash 8fd9887, so fe99104—not the squash aggregate, later directory move ff31abe66cfd46f8cccca00ad708529e4d920144, or subsequent refactors—is the BIC. The vulnerable integrated tree precedes affected release tag 2024.04.28, while direct fix 2f77000 is present in the pseudo-version/tag boundary b03af0e/3000.11.2 and rejects path separators by regenerating invalid IDs. Finally, only the fe99104 commit object was used for attribution: it has a human author/committer and no AI marker or trailer. The causal BIC is thus closed as NOT_AI.
